title: Doty's disinformation to Moulton Howe and Bennewitz

tellings.quote: He admits that he says maybe I because he was forced to drink a liquid and then he was given information that looked like the same information Rick Dodie gave Linda Molton How and Paul Benowitz in 79.

Finally, the documents about the origins of humanity that were given to Lazar are insanely similar to those shown to Linda Moulton Howe to read at Kirtland Air Force Base by none other than Rick Doty.

as_told.title: Origins-of-humanity documents shown to Lazar and Linda Moulton Howe
as_told.place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

plain: Documents about the origins of humanity that Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site, says he was shown look very much like the ones an Air Force intelligence agent named Richard Doty showed the journalist Linda Moulton Howe at Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico. Jesse Michels makes this comparison himself in two episodes: in 2025 he says Lazar admits he was forced to drink a liquid before being given the material, and ties it to what Doty gave Howe and a businessman named Paul Bennewitz in 1979, while in 2024 he speaks only of Howe. If true, it would suggest Lazar was fed the same planted story Doty is known for passing on.
